title_en: The Methodology of Salafi-Wahhabism and Followers of Umayyad Islam in Dealing with Divergent Opinions
description_en: Excerpts from the program Debates in Creed by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari (may his shadow endure).
summary: A critical look at the historical and contemporary methodologies employed by Salafi-Wahhabi movements and Umayyad-oriented traditions when interacting with differing viewpoints.
